title: The Hasp and Hinge Discipline
summary: The school course in closing the foe with a hasp and swinging the seal shut on its hinge for the school's final snap.

title: Manual of the Twin Bolt Guard
summary: The school manual of guarding with two bolts of sealed qi thrown across the line so one holds if the other is forced.

title: The Domed Seal Canon
summary: The school canon of raising a dome of sealed qi over the field and closing it so nothing crosses it either way.

title: Reckoning of the Last Seal
summary: The school's high reckoning of the capstone that is set on a stance or a field and finishes every seal beneath it.

title: The Gale Hushseal Discipline
summary: The school discipline of sealing the foe in a hush so quiet that the whole sworn field goes still around him.

title: Reckoning of the Knotted Oath
summary: The school reckoning of oaths tied in knots of sealed qi that hold a foe for as long as the oath is kept.

title: The Anchorseal Canon
summary: The school canon of the anchor set in sealed qi so that the user stands fast and the foe is held in the same place.

title: The Oath Beneath the Seal
summary: The school's deepest oath sworn beneath all the other seals and laid last upon the foe as the final deepseal.
